## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (integration tests when I/O is involved)
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass
- [ ] API changes start in `api/openapi.yaml`, and `make generate` was run
- [ ] User-facing strings in `en` and `pt-BR`
- [ ] No secret can reach logs, errors, responses or exports
- [ ] Spec, ADR and docs site updated where behavior changed
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
